message.content:
Renting an apartment in New York City varies widely based on neighborhood, size, and amenities. On average:

| Neighborhood | Typical 1‑bedroom rent (monthly) |
|--------------|----------------------------------|
| Manhattan (mid‑town, mid‑west) | $3,000–$4,500 |
| Brooklyn (Williamsburg, Bushwick) | $2,200–$3,800 |
| Queens (Astoria, Long Island City) | $1,800–$3,200 |
| Bronx (Fordham, Riverdale) | $1,400–$2,600 |
| Staten Island | $1,200–$2,300 |

These figures are averages; luxury buildings can exceed $7,000/month, while older or smaller units may fall below $1,500/month. Prices also fluctuate seasonally and with market demand.
